 PM Modi reaffirms India’s support for peaceful resolution of Ukraine conflict 
 News On AIR | 
 November 10, 2026 11:04 AM 
 PM Modi reaffirms India’s support for peaceful resolution of Ukraine conflict
 Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a telephone conversation with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy yesterday. 
 During the conversation, President Zelenskyy shared his perspective on the latest developments related to the ongoing conflict. During the telephonic conversation, Prime Minister reaffirmed India’s human-centric approach and reiterated India’s consistent position that the conflict must be resolved through dialogue and diplomacy. Mr Modi conveyed India’s readiness to contribute to all efforts aimed at peaceful resolution of the conflict.  
 The two leaders also discussed measures to further strengthen India-Ukraine bilateral cooperation in various sectors for the mutual benefit of the people of both countries.
